out.title: Sangeeta Shetty appointed Company Secretary and Compliance Officer
out.summary: Board approved change in authorised Key Managerial Personnel for SEBI LODR disclosures due to new Company Secretary and Compliance Officer Ms. Sangeeta Shetty, effective November 2, 2026.

person.name: Ms. Sangeeta Shetty
person.role: Chief Compliance Officer and Company Secretary
person.bio: Appointed as Chief Compliance Officer and Company Secretary of Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited, replacing the previous Company Secretary; no further background provided in the filing.
